verses.en: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.
verses.pt: Ele: Como tu és bela, minha querida! Como tu és bela! Teus olhos por trás do véu são como pombas; teu cabelo é como um rebanho de cabras, que descem do monte Gileade.
verses.en_web: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are doves behind your veil. Your hair is as a flock of goats, that descend from Mount Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: See, you are fair, my love, you are fair; you have the eyes of a dove; your hair is as a flock of goats, which take their rest on the side of Gilead.

verses.en: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.
verses.pt: Teus dentes são como ovelhas tosquiadas, que sobem do lavatório; todas elas têm gêmeos, e nenhuma delas é estéril.
verses.en_web: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock, which have come up from the washing, where every one of them has twins. None is bereaved among them.
verses.en_bbe: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep whose wool is newly cut, which come up from the washing; every one has two lambs, and there is not one without young.

verses.en: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
verses.pt: Teus lábios são como uma fita de escarlate, e tua boca é bonita; tuas têmporas são como pedaços de romã por detrás do véu.
verses.en_web: Your lips are like scarlet thread. Your mouth is lovely. Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.
verses.en_bbe: Your red lips are like a bright thread, and your mouth is fair of form; the sides of your head are like pomegranate fruit under your veil.

verses.en: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
verses.pt: Teu pescoço é como a torre de Davi, construída como fortaleza; mil escudos estão nela pendurados, todos escudos de guerreiros.
verses.en_web: Your neck is like David’s tower built for an armory, whereon a thousand shields hang, all the shields of the mighty men.
verses.en_bbe: Your neck is like the tower of David made for a store-house of arms, in which a thousand breastplates are hanging, breastplates for fighting-men.

verses.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
verses.pt: Teus dois seios são como dois filhos gêmeos da corça, que pastam entre os lírios.
verses.en_web: Your two breasts are like two fawns that are twins of a roe, which feed among the lilies.
verses.en_bbe: Your two breasts are like two young roes of the same birth, which take their food among the lilies.

verses.en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
verses.pt: Antes do dia nascer, e das sombras fugirem, irei ao monte de mirra, e ao morro do incenso.
verses.en_web: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, to the hill of frankincense.
verses.en_bbe: Till the evening comes, and the sky slowly becomes dark, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.

verses.en: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.
verses.pt: Tu és bela, minha querida! Não há defeito algum em ti.
verses.en_web: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
verses.en_bbe: You are all fair, my love; there is no mark on you.

verses.en: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
verses.pt: Vem comigo do Líbano, ó esposa minha, vem comigo do Líbano; desce do cume de Amaná, do cume de Senir e de Hermom, das montanhas das leoas, dos montes dos leopardos.
verses.en_web: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
verses.en_bbe: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon; see from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the places of the lions, from the mountains of the leopards.

verses.en: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.
verses.pt: Tomaste meu coração, minha irmã, minha esposa; tomaste o meu coração com um de teus olhos, com um colar de teu pescoço.
verses.en_web: You have ravished my heart, my sister, my bride. You have ravished my heart with one of your eyes, with one chain of your neck.
verses.en_bbe: You have taken away my heart, my sister, my bride; you have taken away my heart, with one look you have taken it, with one chain of your neck!

verses.en: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
verses.pt: Como são agradáveis os teus amores, minha irmã, minha esposa! São bem melhores do que o vinho; e o cheiro de teus unguentos é melhor que todas as especiarias.
verses.en_web: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine! The fragrance of your perfumes than all kinds of spices!
verses.en_bbe: How fair is your love, my sister! How much better is your love than wine, and the smell of your oils than any perfume!

verses.en: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
verses.pt: Favos de mel descem de teus lábios, ó esposa; mel e leite estão debaixo de tua língua; e o cheiro de teus vestidos é como o cheiro do Líbano.
verses.en_web: Your lips, my bride, drip like the honeycomb. Honey and milk are under your tongue. The smell of your garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: Your lips are dropping honey; honey and milk are under your tongue; and the smell of your clothing is like the smell of Lebanon.

verses.en: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
verses.pt: Jardim fechado és tu, minha irmã, minha esposa; manancial fechado, uma fonte selada.
verses.en_web: A locked up garden is my sister, my bride; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.
verses.en_bbe: A garden walled-in is my sister, my bride; a garden shut up, a spring of water stopped.

verses.en: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,
verses.pt: Tuas plantas são uma horta de romãs, com frutos excelentes: hena e nardo.
verses.en_web: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits: henna with spikenard plants,
verses.en_bbe: The produce of the garden is pomegranates; with all the best fruits, henna and spikenard,

verses.en: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:
verses.pt: Nardo, açafrão, cálamo e canela; com todo tipo de árvores de incenso: mirra, aloés, com todas as melhores especiarias.
verses.en_web: spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree; myrrh and aloes, with all the best spices,
verses.en_bbe: Spikenard and safron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices.

verses.en: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
verses.pt: Tu és uma fonte de jardins, um poço de águas vivas que corre do Líbano.
verses.en_web: a fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, flowing streams from Lebanon.
verses.en_bbe: You are a fountain of gardens, a spring of living waters, and flowing waters from Lebanon.

verses.en: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.
verses.pt: Ela: Levanta-te, vento norte! E vem, ó vento sul! Assopra em meu jardim, para que espalhem os seus aromas! Que meu amado venha a seu jardim, e coma de seus excelentes frutos.
verses.en_web: Awake, north wind; and come, you south! Blow on my garden, that its spices may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and taste his precious fruits.
verses.en_bbe: Be awake, O north wind; and come, O south, blowing on my garden, so that its spices may come out. Let my loved one come into his garden, and take of his good fruits.
